verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents several in-product AI features that turn customer data into suggestions. Comply AI for Risk generates inherent and residual risk scores, treatments, and justifications. Comply AI pulls answers out of vendor documents, AI generates SSPs, POA&Ms, and SPRS scores from real-time compliance data, and it suggests auto-generated infrastructure-as-code fixes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, and evidence of general cross-dataset insights or analytics beyond these specific workflows.
